RAIDS AI | Senior Technical Project Manager (Full Stack) | REMOTE | Python, Django, FastAPI, React, TypeScript

RAIDS AI is a Cyprus-based AI runtime monitoring and assurance company.

We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to manage a small team of full-stack developers and AI researchers while actively contributing to software development.

Requirements:

7+ years of full-stack development experience

Proven engineering leadership and project management skills

Hands-on coding, architecture, and code review experience

Strong Python (Django/FastAPI), React, and TypeScript skills

Excellent English communication skills

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a project management-only position.

Full job description: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4483409995/

To apply, email rita@raidsai.ai with your CV, a brief cover letter including an example of a team or project you've led, and GitHub links.
